name: osis
description: Use the Amazon OpenSearch Ingestion API to create and manage ingestion pipelines.

subcommands.name: create-pipeline
subcommands.description: Creates an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.

subcommands.name: create-pipeline-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates a VPC endpoint for an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.

subcommands.name: delete-pipeline
subcommands.description: Deletes an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.

subcommands.name: delete-pipeline-endpoint
subcommands.description: Deletes a VPC endpoint for an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes a resource-based policy from an OpenSearch Ingestion resource.

subcommands.name: get-pipeline
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.

subcommands.name: get-pipeline-blueprint
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a specific blueprint for OpenSearch Ingestion.

subcommands.name: get-pipeline-change-progress
subcommands.description: Returns progress information for the current change happening on an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the resource-based policy attached to an OpenSearch Ingestion resource.

subcommands.name: list-pipeline-blueprints
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all available blueprints for Data Prepper.

subcommands.name: list-pipeline-endpoint-connections
subcommands.description: Lists the pipeline endpoints connected to pipelines in your account.

subcommands.name: list-pipeline-endpoints
subcommands.description: Lists all pipeline endpoints in your account.

subcommands.name: list-pipelines
subcommands.description: Lists all OpenSearch Ingestion pipelines in the current Amazon Web Services account and Region.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all resource tags associated with an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches a resource-based policy to an OpenSearch Ingestion resource.

subcommands.name: revoke-pipeline-endpoint-connections
subcommands.description: Revokes pipeline endpoints from specified endpoint IDs.

subcommands.name: start-pipeline
subcommands.description: Starts an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.

subcommands.name: stop-pipeline
subcommands.description: Stops an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Tags an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.

subcommands.name: update-pipeline
subcommands.description: Updates an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline.

subcommands.name: validate-pipeline
subcommands.description: Checks whether an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline configuration is valid prior to creation.
